Usage: [command] [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Process a NuGet package and create a CompLog file.

Arguments:
  [0] <string>     The NuGet package identifier (e.g., Newtonsoft.Json)
  [1] <string?>    The package version (e.g., 13.0.3). If not specified, uses latest stable version.

Options:
  --assembly <string?>    Which assembly to capture when the package ships several for one target framework (e.g. nunit.framework.dll). Defaults to the one named after the package. [Default: null]
  --skip-generators       Do not load or run source generator assemblies in this process. Their documents are then passed as plain source files, which cannot reproduce the original PDB exactly.

Commands:
  apply     Apply patches and rebuild assemblies.
  diff      Create a patch from changes made to an ejected package.
  eject     Eject a NuGet package into an editable source project.
  swap      Swap a project's PackageReference for the package built from its recovered source:
     ejects the package into an editable project with a generated .csproj and rewrites the
     consuming project to use a ProjectReference instead.
  verify    Verify a package round-trips: create a complog, rebuild from it with the exact compiler,
     and byte-compare the result against the assembly shipped in the package.
